channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Mamata’s party files police complaint over alleged ‘knife attack attempt’ on former CM near her home
item.description: There were no reports of any injuries to the former Chief Minister

item.title: Rupee rises 44 paise to 94.92 against U.S. dollar in early trade
item.description: The rupee gained for a fourth straight session, helped by RBI measures to curb speculative trading, as Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said the currency had depreciated “significantly” over the past 18 months

item.title: Delhi Police registers four FIRs against ‘rumour-mongers’, Pakistan social media handles under scanner
item.description: Cases have been registered against social media handles allegedly disseminating misleading information, attempting to create an “anti-India narrative” and disturb law and order, officials said

item.title: SIR: Special camps on October 15, 16 to help enrol omitted voters in Telangana
item.description: First-time electors can also apply for enrolment through Form-6; though the claims and objections period has ended, enrolment will remain open until November 7

item.title: Two Assistant Professors, two PG students suspended for medical negligence at Kakinada GGH
item.description: Rangaraya Medical College Principal says a cannula was left in the woman’s abdomen during delivery surgery and was removed after she was readmitted with stomach pain

item.title: J&K Waqf Board takes U-turn on uniform Friday sermons
item.description: Chairperson Darakshan Andrabi said preachers, not politicians, would decide on sermon topics, two days after first proposing a committee to pre-decide them; Opposition had called the move interference in religious affairs

item.title: Towards an age-ready Keralam: translating rights into care
item.description: The Keralam Senior Citizens (Care and Protection of Rights) Bill, 2026, a first-of-its-kind legislation in the country, is a welcome step towards protecting the rights and well-being of the elderly

item.title: Keralam Senior Citizens Bill referred to Assembly Subject Committee
item.description: Bill aims at promoting healthy and active ageing, regulation of senior citizen care centres, capacity-building for family and care givers, and protection of rights, dignity, and social security of the elderly

item.title: Linking Madras, Cuddalore, and Calcutta
item.description: A visit to Fort St. David in Cuddalore, now a heritage guesthouse, reveals an unexpected link to colonial Calcutta through Dr H.E. Busteed, author of Echoes from Old Calcutta

item.title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE | CJP’s Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka sent to 5 days judicial custody in trespassing case
item.description: Delhi Police has filed an FIR against CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and its other members for allegedly trespassing into the Jantar Mantar area without authorisation, said the officials

item.title: Brain damage to toddler: Health Department refers medical negligence case against hospital to Karnataka Medical Council
item.description: During the procedure, the toddler suffered a cardiac arrest in the operation theatre and subsequently sustained severe brain injury due to lack of oxygen.

item.title: Sugarcane growers block roads at various places in Dharwad, Haveri and Gadag districts
item.description: Sugarcane growers staged road blockades at various places in the districts of Dharwad, Gadag and Haveri on Tuesday, demanding a higher price for sugarcane and a revision of the minimum selling price of sugar

item.title: SIT formed to probe suspected extremist links in Keralam’s Ernakulam synagogue arson case
item.description: Preliminary examination of the accused’s mobile phone reportedly revealed videos of the arson incident and communications with individuals and online groups suspected of having foreign links

item.title: Karnataka Health Minister urges public to use alternatives as 108 ambulance workers threaten strike from October 14 night
item.description: Only 350-400 of 750 required ambulances operational; union seeks pay revision, adequate staffing and safety measures

item.title: Former Madhya Pradesh CM Shivraj Singh Chouhan’s twin remarks fuel buzz of rift within State BJP unit
item.description: The latest row hints at mounting pressure on Chief Minister Mohan Yadav amid reports of differences between him and other senior party leaders

item.title: Andhra Pradesh to hold three regional conferences ahead of CII Partnership Summit
item.description: The government has lined up 115 MoUs involving proposed investments of ₹79,628.04 crore and the potential to generate employment for 1,88,038 persons at the three upcoming conferences.

item.title: Special Executive Magistrate sends CJP’s leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka to five-day judicial custody in trespassing case
item.description: The police action follows an FIR registered against them on charges including criminal trespass, violation of a bond and disobedience of orders, among others, officials said

item.title: West Bengal By-elections and what they mean for Opposition politics in the State
item.description: Despite these trends, the margin of victory of the BJP in the recently concluded bypolls at Nandigram and Rejinagar is something that must ring alarm bells for the Opposition parties.

item.title: Punjab anti-drug activist murder: Main accused nabbed from Rajasthan, says sources
item.description: Anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota was murdered in broad daylight on October 13 after confronting the accused, who was running a medical shop, for allegedly selling drugs to an elderly man

item.title: India urges UN human rights mechanisms to avoid politicisation, selectivity
item.description: India also expressed its strong objection to a reference made to it in a UN report on the rights of indigenous peoples focused on demarcation, registration and titling of lands, territories and resources

item.title: Modi speaks to Carney, says India and Canada contribute to stable, prosperous world
item.description: The two Prime Ministers had a phone call as senior Canadian Ministers are in Delhi for talks; India steps up its middle power engagement

item.title: Indian airlines cancel flights to Saudi Arabian cities till Oct 17
item.description: While announcing cancellation of flights to and from Riyadh, Dammam and Jeddah till October 17, Air India also said it was closely monitoring and assessing the developments in the region to resume safe operations

item.title: Muslims disproportionately flagged in Delhi SIR
item.description: Muslims, who form 13.6% of electors on Delhi’s draft roll, made up 20.3% of those flagged for ‘logical discrepancies’ and 30% of those flagged under five reasons indicative of family size by the Election Commission’s ERONET software; in Bihar, which didn’t have ‘logical discrepancy’ checks, Muslims accounted for 18.4% of deleted electors, in line with their 17.7% share in population

item.title: Shiva’s Baraat in Batman’s mask: In the battle of cultural narratives, Rahul Gandhi blends Puranic lore and pop culture idioms
item.description: By anchoring its street protests in the inclusivity of Shivji ki Baraat and Batman’s vigilante aesthetic, the Congress has crafted a visual syntax that challenges the BJP’s monopoly on cultural semiotics.

item.title: Sculptors in Kumartuli bemoan shortage of clay, higher costs, intrusive content creators
item.description: Sculptors say supply curbs delayed work by two months, pushed up raw material costs, and threaten their earnings in the festive season; social media content creators seek ‘exclusive’ shots without consent, the artists say

item.title: Elon Musk and Mukesh Ambani’s feud over Starlink | Explained
item.description: Elon Musk believes that India’s mobile internet market is skewed to favour the Ambani family and that his Starlink service deserves a fair chance in the country. However, critics have pointed to sovereignty and security concerns

item.title: Mamata-led AITC rally against CEC, SIR stopped in Kolkata over lack of police permission
item.description: CM Suvendu Adhikari had directed the police that the processionby Mamata Banerjee loyalist should not be allowed to march a single step.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh MBBS doctors protest over pay disparity, pending salary arrears; announce work boycott
item.description: The doctors also announced a work boycott, adding that no action or decision has been taken despite assurances regarding addressing salary disparity.

item.title: Jantar Mantar no longer a protest site: All about Ramlila Maidan, Burari Ground, and CBD Ground
item.description: The de-notification of Jantar Mantar has drawn criticism from activists and Opposition parties who allege that this is a stifling of the citizens’ right to protest.

item.title: Response to petitions on illegal detention, clampdown is ready, but needs fine-tuning: Centre
item.description: A three-judge Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant extended the time for the government to file the reply affidavit by October 15, 2026

item.title: In meeting with Rubio, Jaishankar raises India’s concerns about sanctions Act
item.description: The External Affairs Minister and the Secretary of State are also understood to be preparing for high-level meetings between U.S. President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi later this year

item.title: U.S. State Secretary Rubio to visit India for energy talks next week; visit to Jamnagar on cards
item.description: Mr. Rubio will first visit Samarkand in Uzbekistan, and will then travel to Mumbai and Jamnagar

item.title: Over a dozen children dead after boat capsizes in Bihar’s Vaishali
item.description: District Magistrate says all the children on the boat were aged 15 or younger; PM Modi, Bihar CM announce ex-gratia

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay seeks more Krishna water for Chennai, Andhra Pradesh CM Naidu makes no commitment
item.description: A.P. will consider the request, depending on the availability of water and the requirements of the State, Naidu tells his Tamil Nadu counterpart, Both Chief Ministers discuss Godavari-Cauvery river linkage

item.title: ECI’s credibility under question: Former CEC Ashok Lavasa
item.description: Former CEC flags unprecedented voter anxiety over SIR, says institutional response to voting rights has been deeply upsetting

item.title: Odisha Cabinet passes resolution praising Narendra Modi for completing 25 years in public life
item.description: Odisha CM Mohan Majhi said that under Narendra Modi’s leadership, India has become a ‘completely transformed and new India’

item.title: The fight for an equitable education: How Samacheer Kalvi came to existence in Tamil Nadu
item.description: In 2011, the transition to the uniform system of school education in Tamil Nadu faced a political hurdle when the AIADMK came to power

item.title: Karnataka MLC Ravi Kumar accuses Rahul Gandhi of ‘insulting’ Kannadigas by ‘pushing out’ Chief Minister
SC/ST voices condemn Karnataka Hight Court verdict striking down enhanced reservation
item.description: Various individuals and organisations representing Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes communities in the State expressed deep disappointment with the Karnataka High Court verdict that struck down the enhanced reservation

item.title: Anna Seve app to be available across Karnataka from October 14
item.description: Over 1.6 lakh beneficiaries completed e-KYC during pilot; October 20 is deadline

item.title: Union Minister Kumaraswamy seeks CBI probe into alleged ‘sting operation’, urges Siddaramaiah to speak up
item.description: Siddaramaiah, who got a injunction order on Tuesday, has also lodged a complaint with the Bengaluru City Police Commissioner seeking an investigation into the alleged ‘sting’ video

item.title: Goa Police defend detention of seven CJP members before High Court, cite history of protests without permission
item.description: The police denied the allegations of use of force

item.title: CEC protests: Bombay High Court says won’t allow detentions that violate law
item.description: The Bench asked the petitioner to document detentions in Mumbai CEC protests, lists matter for October 19

item.title: Patna High Court acquits 13 accused in 1996 Jehanabad quadruple murder case
item.description: A Division Bench comprising Justice Rajeev Ranjan Prasad and Justice Kumar Manish delivered the ruling, citing grave lapses in the police investigation

item.title: Man held on charge of setting fire to boards outside Kadavumbhagam synagogue in Keralam’s Kochi
Kerala High Court dismisses plea by accused in Abhimanyu Murder case to stay trial until completion of investigation
T.J. Vinod, MLA, raises Kochi’s water scarcity issue in Keralam Assembly
WRD begins removal of invasive plants from irrigation tanks along Palar River in Vellore
item.description: WRD officials said that on an average, around 15 tonnes of invasive plants grew in one acre of irrigation tank

item.title: Boy dies of burns in Tirupattur
item.description: The police said that even as his father and neighbours tried to put out the fire, the boy sustained grievous burns and the father sustained minor burns

item.title: Bank staffer among three persons held for circulating counterfeit currencies in Vellore
item.description: The police recovered counterfeit currencies totalling upto ₹8,700

item.title: Women’s quota for GVMC Mayor post sets off lobbying; senior leaders push spouses and daughters
item.description: The TDP cites its hold on Visakhapatnam’s core constituencies to claim the post; the BJP, the Jana Sena and the YSRCP have aspirants too

item.title: Basic research is key to development of applications, says scientist
item.description: He highlighted the importance of stem cells and gene therapies that have reached a large number of patients worldwide

item.title: Kochi’s tail-end areas parched as water crisis deepens
item.description: Residents in Valappilkadavu Road say over 100 houses have been affected, with households spending ₹800 to ₹1,000 a week on tanker water; residents in several areas, including SRM Road, Pachalam, Vaduthala and Kannachan Thodu, report acute water shortages; KWA sources attribute the supply pressure problems to increased consumption and the reduced functioning of the Thammanam tank

item.title: City hospital organises breast cancer awareness programme
NH works not gaining pace in Keralam: Minister
Anger mounts in Punjab after anti-drug crusader killed in broad daylight
item.description: Confronted over illegal sale of addictive substances, medical store owner shoots down activist; Mansa residents stage massive protests; family refuses to cremate body; Oppn. corners AAP govt.

item.title: Amit Shah slams SIR protests, says Congress will suffer its fourth consecutive defeat in 2029
item.description: The trust of people cannot be earned through manufactured media events and the echo of falsehoods, says Home Minister

item.title: Woman Circle Officer slaps advocate amid row over parking, apologises after lawyers stage protest in Ajmer
Political resistance against vote chori will continue, not as parallel protests but as one movement: Rahul Gandhi
item.description: Rahul Gandhi hosted leaders from 16 Opposition parties, civil society and student activists in a bid to coordinate diverse strands of the agitation; his office tried reaching out to CJP leaders, but it did not work out

item.title: High-cost power to be purchased for 16 days to avoid unscheduled cuts, says Minister
item.description: The current peak power demand is 21,000 MW when compared to 16,000 MW last year — a 30% increase due to the El Niño effect, says Nirmal Kumar
